newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 29.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 29.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:
** The Dow Jones Industrial Average ended up 1.11 points at 5,712.38 on Wednesday in slow trading ahead of the Labour Day holiday weekend.
** Law suit by ousted Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) leader Megawati Sukarnoputri against political rivals/government resumes in Jakarta Central District Court on Thursday.
** The Jakarta Composite Index fell 1.10 points, or 0.20 percent, to close at 548.42 points on Wednesday after across the board consolidation due to a lack of support from regional markets.
** On Thursday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,343.10/43.40 in early trading against an opening of 2,343.00/44.00.
** Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper on announcement of sharp falls in H1 net profit.
** Lippo Securities, Lippo Life and Lippo Bank on announcements of share purchases.
** Textile firm Karwell on market talk of a possible rights issue.
** Property firm Putra Surya Perkasa on continued market talk of an alliance with another property firm.
